_about: How the served models are titled. The publisher's titles are inconsistent (BeModelCarePlan, Problem Logical Model, Medication (model), none at all), so build_content.py sets the title of every served copy to the convention `<Concept> Logical Model`, derived from the model's name: the BeModel prefix and a trailing Model or DataSet are dropped, the rest is split into words, acronyms kept (PSS Request Logical Model, Annex 81 Logical Model). `titles` lists the names the rule cannot handle and the title to use. The published title stays untouched in input/models/.
